description: Frozen processed OBIS occurrence-cell aggregates for offline replay of the original 157-candidate training run. These are not raw OBIS records and are not a fresh download.
processed_data_steps: The original download was scoped to OBIS areaid=140; no download occurs in this replay package.
Species names were resolved from OBIS species fields; genus-level unidentified records were not invented as species.

Absent/dropped/invalid-coordinate records and the recorded non-marine quality flags were filtered. Known coordinate uncertainty above 25 km was excluded; unknown uncertainty was allowed and does not imply precise coordinates.
Both occurrence coordinates and 0.1-degree cell centres had to fall within the frozen Malaysia EEZ geometry.
At least one accepted observation makes a species-cell positive. Observation counts do not become training weights. All other marine cells are background zero.
The frozen candidate scope contains 151 animals and six marine seagrasses, each with at least ten distinct positive cells; no extra one-degree spatial-block or date gate was used.
Only these 157 scientific-name rows and their presence cells were copied for portable replay. The historical tier field was removed.
license_note: Attributions and license values below are copied from occurrence metadata. Some records are CC-BY-NC or have no supplied license; this package does not grant new rights or provide photograph licenses. Review the underlying dataset terms before reuse. Null metadata remains unknown.
